# Psalm 59 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Al-Tashcheth. Of-David. A-Miktam, when Saul sent and-they-watched the-house to-kill-him.

**2** Deliver-me from-my-enemies, my-God; from-those-rising against-me set-me-on-high.

**3** Deliver-me from-workers of-iniquity, and-from-men of-blood save-me.

**4** For behold, they-lie-in-wait for-my-soul; fierce-ones gather against-me — not-for my-transgression and-not-for my-sin, YHWH.

**5** Without iniquity [of mine] they-run and-prepare-themselves. Awake to-meet-me, and-see!

**6** And-You, YHWH God of-hosts, God of-Israel, rouse-Yourself to-punish all the-nations; do-not be-gracious to-any-treacherous-evildoer. Selah.

**7** They-return at-evening; they-growl like-a-dog and-go-around the-city.

**8** Behold, they-belch with-their-mouth; swords [are] on-their-lips — for 'Who hears?'

**9** But-You, YHWH, laugh at-them; You-mock all the-nations.

**10** O-my-Strength, to-You I-watch, for God [is] my-fortress.

**11** My-God of-steadfast-love comes-to-meet-me; God lets-me-look upon-my-enemies.

**12** Do-not kill-them, lest my-people forget; make-them-wander by-Your-power and-bring-them-down, O-Lord, our-shield.

**13** The-sin of-their-mouth [is] the-word of-their-lips; and-let-them-be-caught in-their-pride, and-for-the-cursing and-the-lying they-recount.

**14** Consume [them] in-wrath; consume and-let-them-be no-more; and-let-them-know that God rules in-Jacob, to-the-ends of-the-earth. Selah.

**15** And-they-return at-evening; they-growl like-a-dog and-go-around the-city.

**16** They wander-about for-food; if they-are-not satisfied, they-growl.

**17** But-I sing of-Your-strength; I-shout-for-joy in-the-morning [of] Your-steadfast-love, for You-have-been a-fortress to-me and-a-refuge in-the-day of-my-distress.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **59:7**: The dog imagery recurs (vv.7, 15) — prowling, howling, scavenging. Enemies are dehumanized as predatory animals circling their prey.

— EMET
